items.text: Most guides answer with a list of institutes. The better question is four questions, because the answer to each is different.

items.text: Each stage below is a separate competition. Clearing one does not carry you through the next. This is multi-stage competition: a hard entry filter, then a different hard filter much later.

items.heading: Verdict
items.text: Verdict: good to study if the questions pull you, weak as a single job plan. Run a data or software skill beside it from the first year.

items.heading: Lead with the Routes That
items.text: Lead with the routes that can grow: data work first, then instruments, teaching and astro-tourism. Planetarium posts, ISRO-adjacent roles and the research ladder stay in, marked Not so scalable.

items.heading: Next Step
items.text: Next step: finish one small analysis of open sky-survey data and show it to three people who do the work. Avoid a loan for the degree.
